title: types: arm the registered types that pass the criterion or a standing ruling (object-pivot, embeddable-form, detail-section, app-schema-renderer, page kinds home/record/utility); fold spec-report into report — objectui#10859 follow-up
body:
This card carries the eight keys that pass the criterion, per the seat ruling `5945530142` and its amendment `5945583855` on objectui#10859. The parent objectui#10859 keeps the `REFUSED_AT_TYPE` ratchet, the retirements (batch 8, phases 2a and 2b) and the three box keys.

Filing-gate category: ① a defect family with named sites, class (a), a sub-issue of in-flight objectui#10859. It carries the parent's `domain:ui` and `priority:p2` (triage `5860727647` item 3: "Keys that pass it become one follow-up card listing them"). `reach:` public door, measured by the batch-8 dev at objectui `d8edfe257` (report `5945491717`):
- `objectui validate` refuses `{ type: 'home', name, regions }` at `type`, the spec's own page shape (`{ type: 'page', pageType: 'home' }` passes);
- it refuses the plugin-detail README's `detail-view` document at `tabs.0.content`, because the README teaches a `detail-section` node there.

Reader who acts: `domain:ui` seat 1 (`session_01YLg8XqWGJ785fwQ5v4pH37`), dispatched after objectui#10859 batch 8 phase 2b lands. That ordering is serial on the ratchet pin and `known-schema-types.ts`.

## The keys (registration, producers and readings are the dev's measurement in `5945491717`)

| key | registration | why it passes (mainstream reading cited in `5945491717`) | what this card does |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `object-pivot` | `plugin-dashboard` `register('object-pivot', ObjectPivotBlock)`; `PUBLIC_BLOCKS` Tier A | object-bound pivot (`pbiMatrix`) | declare it locally from its registration inputs (spec 17.5.0 `ComponentPropsMap` has no row), then arm it |
| `embeddable-form` | `plugin-form` `register('embeddable-form', …)`, `formId` + `objectName` required; Tier A | embeddable public form (`airtableForm`) | declare and arm it |
| `detail-section` | `plugin-detail` `register('detail-section', DetailSectionNode)` | field section on a record page (`sfFieldSection`); taught by the plugin-detail README inside `detail-view` `tabs[].content`, refused today | declare and arm it, or fold it into `record:details` sections if measurement shows that is the same shape (the dev's note) |
| `home`, `record`, `utility` | `page.tsx` registers each as `PageRenderer` (objectui#9642: "THESE KEYS ARE PAGE KINDS") | spec 17.5.0 `PageSchema.type` is `record \| home \| app \| utility \| list`; app-shell `PageView` writes a stored page's kind into `type`; objectui#9576 closed not_planned on exactly this (`sfPageTypes`) | arm the spec's spelling by reference, so a spec page document validates |
| `app-schema-renderer` | `layout` `register('app-schema-renderer', AppSchemaRenderer)`; it declares `inputs` | standing maintainer decisions, not the mainstream reading: objectui#4841's ruling (`5307574602`) keeps it "the one JSON door for 'render a whole shell from a schema'", and the maintainer-approved governed guide `skills/objectui/guides/mobile.md` (PR objectui#11397) teaches its SDUI node key as a `mobileNavMode` channel, which `objectui validate` refuses today | declare it from its registration inputs, then arm it, so the node the published guide teaches validates |
| `spec-report` | `plugin-report` `register('spec-report', ReportRenderer)`, the same dispatcher as the armed `report`; `DrillDownDrawer` emits it | embed a saved report (`sfStdComponents`), but the spelling is an alias | `report` declares the wrapper shape `spec-report` carries (today the strict face refuses `{ type: 'report', report }` as `unrecognized_keys`); move `DrillDownDrawer` and the docs to `report`; then unregister `spec-report` with a tombstone (the objectui#8760 one-spelling route) |

## Premises (re-check at claim)
- `REFUSED_AT_TYPE` after batch 8 is 10: these 7 keys plus the 3 box keys. Re-check with `pnpm exec vitest run packages/cli/src/__tests__/registered-types-validate-ratchet-10859.test.ts` and the pin's own count. This card takes it to 2 (the two box keys, `navigation-renderer` and `responsive-grid`).
- Which page spelling is canonical (objectui's `type: 'page'` + `pageType`, or the spec's `type: <kind>`) is not this card's to change. It arms the spec's spelling because the spec declares it; any retirement of a spelling is a separate question for triage.
- `Clause-②: yes` (arms widen the accept set), so the at-tier contract review is owed before ACCEPT, as objectui#10859 batch 7's was.

- `embeddable-form` 2 (closed PRs objectui#11113, objectui#10870);
- `detail-section` 1 (closed PR objectui#10870, batch 1, which only lists it);
- `spec-report` 11, all closed: JoinedReportBlock derivation, data reads;
- `app-schema-renderer` 7, all closed: the objectui#11363 / objectui#11211 / objectui#11362 / objectui#11395 mobile-nav family and their PRs, none about arming it;
- a bare `type: 'home'` / `'utility'` literal 5, none about arming the kinds (objectui#11423's pages and the PRs around it);
- control: `known-schema-types` / `KNOWN_SCHEMA_TYPES` 19, objectui#10859 among them.

None carries this follow-up.
